next.reason: The bar on the implementor's 9x conditions is widened. 1985: 'This condition must not duplicate any condition specified for the I-O status values 00 through 49' (§1985:IX.1.3.4). 2023: 'This condition shall not duplicate any other condition specified by another I-O status value' (§2023:9.1.13.11 GR1), which now also excludes the 5x, 6x and 7x conditions. A 1985 program reaches these: with no SHARING phrase or clause 'the implementor defines the sharing mode in which the file is opened' (§2023:9.1.15), and an OPEN that conflicts with another file connector is status 61 (§2023:9.1.13.9 GR1), a condition a 1985 implementor could report as 9x. The value of x stays implementor-defined (§2023:A.1 110).
